answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding collateral in per-identity escrows and linking equivocation evidence across identities: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting statements, their pairwise violations grow as k(k−1)/2, so penalties scale as O(k²). Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, amplified by asymmetric depreciation of forfeited collateral. Whether the evidence arrives in willow, river, or dawn epochs, splitting stake across aliases cannot dilute correlated risk.
